ja430:1.1: Santi rukkhā haritapattā dumā nekaphalā bahū, kasmā nu sukkhe koḷāpe sukassa nirato mano.
ja430:2.1: Phal' assa upabhuñjimha nekavassagaṇe bahū, aphalam pi viditvāna sā va metti yathā pure.
ja430:3.1: {Sukkhañ} ca rukkhaṃ koḷāpaṃ opattam aphalaṃ dumaṃ ohāya sakuṇā yanti, kiṃ dosaṃ passase dija.
ja430:4.1: Ye phalaṭṭhā saṃbhajanti aphalo ti jahanti naṃ, attaṭṭhapaññā dummedhā te honti pakkhapātino.
ja430:5.1: Sādhu sakkhi kataṃ hoti mittaṃ saṃsati santhavo, sac' etaṃ dhammaṃ rocesi pāsaṃso si vijānataṃ.
ja430:6.1: So te suva varaṃ dammi pattayāna vihaṅgama, varaṃ varassu vakkaṅga yaṃ kiñci manas' icchasi.
ja430:7.1: Api nāma naṃ passemu sapattaṃ saphalaṃ dumaṃ, daliddo va nidhiṃ laddhā nandeyy' āhaṃ punappunaṃ.
ja430:8.1: Tato amatam ādāya abhisiñci mahīruhaṃ, tassa sākhā virūhiṃsu sītacchāyā manoramā.
ja430:9.1: Evaṃ Sakka sakhī hohi saha sabbehi ñātibhi yathāham ajja sukhito disvāna saphalaṃ dumaṃ.
ja430:10.1: Suvassa ca varaṃ datvā katvāna saphalaṃ dumaṃ pakkāmi saha bhariyāya devānaṃ Nandanaṃ vanan ti.
